_doc: The Ledger for the ruins game (design/ruins/content.md §6): every entry the story can teach (kind clue, insight, person, model, trial or question) and the death screen's line for each way a loop ends. A question opens when anything in `opens` is learned and lists the `clues` that bear on it; R2 adds its answers.

orrery_light.title: The light in the Orrery
orrery_light.text: The last thing I remember: the great rings turning wrong, Wren a step ahead of me on the gallery, and a light with no colour.

carried_out.title: Carried out
carried_out.text: Mira saw a veiled figure leave me at the east gate before dawn. It carried me like I weighed nothing, then walked back the way it came.

backward_prints.title: Prints at the east gate
backward_prints.text: Scuffed prints in the ash at the east gate, coming out. The heels are where the toes should be.

wren_cipher.title: Wren's hobby
wren_cipher.text: Pell says the College's old star cipher was Wren's hobby. Wren wrote notes to people in it.

knights_camp.title: Riders at the fence
knights_camp.text: Knights of the Iron Oath rode up the east road at dusk on Ashmoon 2 and camped a bowshot from the wagons. Their captain wants the name of every wizard who casts fire.

mill_cellars.title: The Mill cellars
mill_cellars.text: Aldous says things came up out of the Mill cellars the night the Orrery fell.

rune_ashlar.title: The rune Ashlar
rune_ashlar.text: The dwarves stamp their tools with Ashlar, the rune of the stone that holds. Their doors answer to it.

rune_shape.title: A rune on a sealed door
rune_shape.text: A door in the College halls, sealed with a dwarf rune. I know its shape now.

the_halls.title: The College halls
the_halls.text: Under the north stair, the College halls go on in the dark. The blast went down as well as up.

second_blast.title: The second blast
second_blast.text: At the Eclipse the Orrery's heart woke again, and this time it took everything.

shrine_release.title: The shrines answer
shrine_release.text: An Orrery shrine in the ruin will let a loop go if I ask it. I wake on the cot, the morning after.

hours_stirs.title: The Hours stir
hours_stirs.text: Something came back with me: the Hours, the College's own Sphere. Rewind, the first of its Models, is mine to put in my spellbook.

died_patrol.title: The Hollows in the ruins brought me down
died_patrol.text: At night the Hollows walk the College ruins. Too many to fight in the dark.

mira.title: Mira
mira.text: The lamplighter. Lights the lane at dusk, and saw who brought me in.

aldous.title: Aldous
aldous.text: The miller. Bakes what bread there is, and won't go near his own cellar.

pell.title: Pell
pell.text: Eager to help with anything. Knew the College, or says so.

captain.title: Captain Halloway
captain.text: The watch's captain, eleven watchmen left. Holds the cordon at the College gate. Nobody goes down, except that I do.

pell_children.title: Three names on an arm
pell_children.text: Marta, Hob and little Dain. The Mirror Lake came up in the night twelve years ago, while Pell was at market with the oil. He says he'll have them back.

umbral_taste.title: A name that wasn't mine
umbral_taste.text: At Sister Nobody's fire I whispered a name I didn't know. My shadow lifted, and a torch burned backward into a new candle. It cost a little of me.

cass_fades.title: The portrait
cass_fades.text: Cass drew me in Seedmoon. By the end of it she didn't know me, and looked at her own drawing as if a stranger had made it.

brogan.title: Brogan Tallowmere
brogan.text: Dwarf salvager, came for the Orrery's ring-metal. I got him out from under a beam in the sliced bakery. He says he owes me a road.

fennick.title: Fennick Brass
fennick.text: Guild artificer up from Lantern Quay. Runs the Lantern Market and sells everything, out of forty pockets.

bett.title: Bett
bett.text: Aldous's wife. Runs the camp kitchen and feeds whoever comes.

tam.title: Tam
tam.text: Aldous's youngest, ten. Carries the water. Can't make a Kindle light yet.

nobody.title: Sister Nobody
nobody.text: Keeps a fire at the camp's edge each night for anyone who's lost someone. I can never quite picture her face afterwards.

silas.title: Silas Vane
silas.text: Second-year Storm student. Brilliant, and can't stand me.

cass.title: Cass Vane
cass.text: Silas's sister, sixteen. Laughs too loudly and draws on everything.

kestrel.title: Kestrel
kestrel.text: Guild courier. Sharp, always eating something, and never lets go of the satchel.

dunmore.title: Knight-Captain Dunmore
dunmore.text: Leads the Knights' envoy on the east road. Courteous. Watches everything.

maud.title: Dame Maud Ashby
maud.text: A knight of the envoy, in lead-sealed plate. Very tired eyes.

pike.title: Healer Pike
pike.text: Runs the infirmary. Ex-College, very good with bones.

jory.title: Old Jory
jory.text: The fiddler. His fiddle came through the Shattering. He knows four songs.

model_rewind.title: Rewind (Hours)
model_rewind.text: Learnt from the hanging shard. Step back to where you stood a moment ago.

model_splash.title: Splash (Luna)
model_splash.text: Studied with Wren in the archive.

model_spark.title: Spark (Mercury)
model_spark.text: Studied with Wren in the archive.

model_undertow.title: Undertow (Luna)
model_undertow.text: Studied with Wren in the archive.

model_arc_lance.title: Arc Lance (Mercury)
model_arc_lance.text: Studied with Wren in the archive.

model_spark_flask.title: Spark Flask (device)
model_spark_flask.text: Oil, a spark in the stopper, and keep it away from your face. The Lamplighters' first lesson.

model_arc_rod.title: Arc Rod (device)
model_arc_rod.text: Copper wound round an iron spike. Plant it and let it find them.

model_smoke_jar.title: Smoke Jar (device)
model_smoke_jar.text: Powder that blooms into a cloud. What can't see you can't hit you.

model_star_lantern.title: Star Lantern (combined)
model_star_lantern.text: College work and Lamplighter work in one glass. Hang it, and the stars line up for you.

model_tar_pot.title: Tar Pot (device)
model_tar_pot.text: Pitch for the ground. It holds feet, and it holds a flame longer.

q_wren.title: Where is Wren?
q_wren.text: Wren was ahead of me in the Orrery when the light came.

q_carried.title: Who carried you out?
q_carried.text: Someone brought me out of the ruin and left me at the east gate.

q_rune.title: What opens the rune door?
q_rune.text: A door in the halls is sealed with a dwarf rune.

rune_opened.title: The rune door opens to Ashlar
rune_opened.text: The sealed door in the entrance hall answers to the dwarves' rune, Ashlar. Behind it a passage runs to the Kiln antechamber.

short_route.title: The short way to the Kiln
short_route.text: Through the rune door and the bell passage, the Kiln antechamber is a short walk, with no fight on the way.

glass_fuse.title: The glassworks fuse
glass_fuse.text: Turned right, the glassworks' three mirrors pass the sun into the great lens, and the lens burns a fuse in the wall by the loft stair. Fire on that fuse opens the loft just as well.

glass_notes.title: The glassblower's notes
glass_notes.text: Behind a false wall in the glassworks, a loft full of notes on light: how to fold it, how to keep it, how to send it back.

drain_open.title: The drain under the square
drain_open.text: The undercroft's grate opens into the camp's market cellar. Once the counterweight drags it up, it stays up: a walk from the camp to the city, with no day lost on the road.

holds_shut.title: The Holds gate
holds_shut.text: The dwarves keep the road to the Deep Holds open through Ashmoon. On the first day of Thaw they bar the gate in the rim, and it stays barred.

smoke_vent.title: The waystation vent
smoke_vent.text: A vent behind the waystation breathes from the smugglers' cellar. Burn the hay heaped against it and the smoke goes down, and the smugglers come up.

islet_stone.title: The islet stone
islet_stone.text: A standing stone on the mill pond's islet hums under your hand. Drain the pond at its sluice and you can walk to it.

archive_key.title: The Archive gate
archive_key.text: The plaque on the Archive gate, under its soot: entry by the College's key alone.

crack_order.title: Which crack glows first
crack_order.text: Embers burst out of the cracks in a fixed order. In the entrance hall the west crack always glows first, then the east.

warden_water.title: Water cools the Kiln Warden
warden_water.text: A cracked pipe drips onto the Kiln Warden's grate, and each time it flinches. Water cools it.

sluice_flood.title: The cistern sluice
sluice_flood.text: The sluice wheel in the cistern runs its water down a channel to the Kiln's grate.

burnt_far_side.title: Burnt from the far side
burnt_far_side.text: The door from the Kiln antechamber to the cistern was burnt open from the cistern side: the scorch fans out toward the antechamber.

door_healed.title: The door is whole
door_healed.text: Later in the month the cistern door is whole again, new oak without a mark on it. I saw it burnt to its hinges.

doors_heal.title: Time is wrong down here
doors_heal.text: What was broken early in the month is whole later on. Someone burnt through that door, and the ruin has been healing behind them.

q_door.title: Why did the burnt door heal?
q_door.text: The cistern door was burnt open early in the month, and later it was whole.

trial_warden.title: The Kiln Warden
trial_warden.text: Beaten in the Kiln hall. My Ring rose to the 1st. Next time it should know me.

ember_burst.title: Embers burst
ember_burst.text: An ember bursts into a small patch of fire as it dies. Standing in it burns; water puts it out.

ember_light.title: Embers keep out of the light
ember_light.text: Embers won't cross lamplight. In the dark lecture gallery a lit lamp would have kept them off.

backward_stones.title: The Backward Slingers
backward_stones.text: Their stones fly the wrong way: each one appears behind you and flies home to the hand that throws it.

figure_ahead.title: Someone ahead of me
figure_ahead.text: A veiled figure in the entrance hall, facing me. It went backwards through the fallen stair, faster than anyone could run, and never turned round.

wren_chalk.title: A chalk mark in the gallery
wren_chalk.text: In the lecture gallery, a mark in the College's star cipher: the sealed door, and an arrow pointing east, back toward the entrance hall.

stair_cult.title: Chalk on the fallen stair
stair_cult.text: Fresh chalk on the rubble of the stair north of the entrance hall: a circle cut through by a line. The stair was brought down on purpose.

stair_mend.title: The Hours mend the stair
stair_mend.text: A Rewind on the collapsed stair puts it back where it stood, and the way north to the cistern opens, any day of the month.

provost_crossed.title: The Provost at the Eclipse
provost_crossed.text: The great clock, turned back with a Rewind, showed the Provost crossing the entrance hall at the Eclipse, in a hurry, going up toward the Orrery. The stair was whole then.

q_ahead.title: Who is ahead of you?
q_ahead.text: Someone in the halls goes backwards, and goes deeper.

q_halls.title: What happened in the halls?
q_halls.text: The blast went down as well as up. Someone was down here when it came.

q_stair.title: Who brought the stair down?
q_stair.text: The stair to the cistern was brought down on purpose, and marked.

deaths.patrol: The Hollows in the ruins were too many.
deaths.eclipse: The Eclipse came, and the Orrery's heart woke a second time.
deaths.turned: You stopped the rings at the shrine and turned back the Hours.
deaths.fight:hall_fight: The embers in the entrance hall burned you down. The west crack glowed first.
deaths.fight:refectory_fight: The embers in the refectory were too many. Its four cracks glow in the same order every time.
deaths.fight:gallery_fight: The embers in the lecture gallery caught you in the dark. They won't cross a lamp's light.
deaths.fight:ante_fight: The Backward Slingers in the antechamber brought you down.
deaths.fight:warden: The Kiln Warden burned you down. Each time the pipe dripped on its grate, it flinched.
deaths.first_playable_end: The Archive stair is as far as the first playable goes. Thank you for playing! Wake to keep exploring the month: everything you know stays.
